name: DWD pollen hazard index (Germany)
short: Pollen load index for 8 pollen types in 27 German sub-regions, today to day after tomorrow; free JSON.
summary: The German weather service DWD publishes a daily pollen hazard index forecast on its open data server: for each of 27 sub-regions it gives a 0 to 3 load level for hazel, alder, birch, ash, grass, rye, mugwort and ragweed for today, tomorrow and the day after. One JSON file, no key.

tasks: pollen load today in a German region
pollen forecast for the next two days

pricing.notes: Open data server README: weather and climate data are free of charge, without registration.

coverage.notes: 27 sub-regions in 2026-11-08 file. Values are forecast load levels, not particle counts. Most types read 0 in November.

licensing.summary: Legal notice page: all open spatial data and services of DWD may be re-used under CC BY 4.0, acknowledging the source. The Open Data Server README refers to this page as its terms. AI training is not addressed.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Index per region and pollen type for today, tomorrow and day after; legend with level text (German).

api.rate_limits: No service level guaranteed per DWD page; no rate limit stated.
api.notes: German-language field names and legend. The server keeps request IPs for up to 7 days (README).

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each file has a last_update stamp set by DWD; the forecast method is not described in the file.

location.unknown: Coordinates are published by the provider; nothing proves a device or station has not moved.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.

sources.claim: Legal notice: CC BY 4.0 for open spatial data
